                    (function () {
                        var pads = {};
                        var mirror = { pads: function () {} };  // set once markers are wired
                        function setupPad(id) {
                            var canvas = document.getElementById(id);
                            if (!canvas) { return null; }
                            var pad = new SignaturePad(canvas, { penColor: '#11181f' });
                            function resize() {
                                var ratio = Math.max(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1);
                                var data = pad.toData();
                                canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth * ratio;
                                canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight * ratio;
                                canvas.getContext('2d').scale(ratio, ratio);
                                pad.clear();
                                if (data && data.length) { pad.fromData(data); }
                            }
                            window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
                            resize();
                            pads[id] = pad;
                            return pad;
                        }
                        setupPad('bf_pad');
                        setupPad('bf_pad_initials');
                        // Warm up the bundled signature fonts so the first typed render
                        // doesn't flash a system fallback.
                        if (document.fonts && document.fonts.load) {
                            ['Caveat', 'Dancing Script', 'Great Vibes'].forEach(function (f) {
                                document.fonts.load("48px '" + f + "'");
                            });
                        }
                        // ── Typed entry (alternative to drawing) — drives both the ─────────
                        //    signature and the initials pad through one config table.
                        var TYPERS = {
                            signature: { mode: 'draw', pad: 'bf_pad', canvas: 'bf_pad',
                                         row: 'bf_type_row', hint: 'bf_pad_hint',
                                         name: 'bf_type_name', style: 'bf_type_style',
                                         uploadRow: 'bf_up_row', file: 'bf_up_file',
                                         uploaded: false, attr: 'data-sigmode' },
                            initials:  { mode: 'draw', pad: 'bf_pad_initials', canvas: 'bf_pad_initials',
                                         row: 'bf_ini_type_row', hint: 'bf_pad_ini_hint',
                                         name: 'bf_ini_type_name', style: 'bf_ini_type_style',
                                         uploadRow: 'bf_ini_up_row', file: 'bf_ini_up_file',
                                         uploaded: false, attr: 'data-inimode' },
                        };
                        function typedValue(key) {
                            var el = document.getElementById(TYPERS[key].name);
                            return el ? (el.value || '').trim() : '';
                        }
                        // Content present on a pad, by mode: drawn strokes, typed text, or
                        // an uploaded image (the latter two are painted onto the canvas).
                        function hasContent(key) {
                            var t = TYPERS[key];
                            if (t.mode === 'type') { return typedValue(key) !== ''; }
                            if (t.mode === 'upload') { return !!t.uploaded; }
                            var pad = pads[t.pad];
                            return !!(pad && !pad.isEmpty());
                        }
                        // Draw an uploaded JPG/PNG onto the pad canvas (fit, centered) so it
                        // flows through the same canvas → PNG path as drawing and typing.
                        function loadImage(key, file) {
                            var t = TYPERS[key];
                            var canvas = document.getElementById(t.canvas);
                            if (!canvas || !file) { return; }
                            var reader = new FileReader();
                            reader.onload = function () {
                                var img = new Image();
                                img.onload = function () {
                                    var pad = pads[t.pad];
                                    if (pad) { pad.clear(); }
                                    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                                    var w = canvas.offsetWidth, h = canvas.offsetHeight;
                                    var scale = Math.min(w / img.width, h / img.height);
                                    var dw = img.width * scale, dh = img.height * scale;
                                    ctx.drawImage(img, (w - dw) / 2, (h - dh) / 2, dw, dh);
                                    t.uploaded = true;
                                    mirror.pads();
                                };
                                img.onerror = function () {
                                    t.uploaded = false;
                                    alert('Image illisible. Choisissez un fichier PNG ou JPG.');
                                };
                                img.src = reader.result;
                            };
                            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                        }
                        function renderTyped(key) {
                            var t = TYPERS[key];
                            var canvas = document.getElementById(t.canvas);
                            var pad = pads[t.pad];
                            if (!canvas) { return; }
                            var style = document.getElementById(t.style).value;
                            var name = typedValue(key);
                            function draw() {
                                if (pad) { pad.clear(); }
                                if (name) {
                                    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                                    var w = canvas.offsetWidth, h = canvas.offsetHeight;
                                    var size = Math.min(64, Math.floor(h * 0.5));
                                    ctx.fillStyle = '#11181f';
                                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                                    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                                    ctx.font = size + 'px ' + style;
                                    while (size > 16 && ctx.measureText(name).width > w * 0.9) {
                                        size -= 2; ctx.font = size + 'px ' + style;
                                    }
                                    ctx.fillText(name, w / 2, h / 2);
                                }
                                mirror.pads();
                            }
                            // Draw now (so submit always reads a populated canvas), then
                            // redraw once the bundled webfont is ready in case the first
                            // paint fell back to a system font.
                            draw();
                            var fam = (style.match(/'([^']+)'/) || [])[1];
                            if (name && fam && document.fonts && document.fonts.load) {
                                document.fonts.load("48px '" + fam + "'").then(draw, function () {});
                            }
                        }
                        function setMode(key, mode) {
                            var t = TYPERS[key];
                            t.mode = mode;
                            t.uploaded = false;
                            var pad = pads[t.pad];
                            var row = document.getElementById(t.row);
                            var upRow = document.getElementById(t.uploadRow);
                            var fileEl = document.getElementById(t.file);
                            var hint = document.getElementById(t.hint);
                            if (row) { row.style.display = (mode === 'type') ? 'flex' : 'none'; }
                            if (upRow) { upRow.style.display = (mode === 'upload') ? 'block' : 'none'; }
                            if (fileEl) { fileEl.value = ''; }
                            if (hint) { hint.style.display = (mode === 'draw') ? '' : 'none'; }
                            Array.prototype.forEach.call(
                                document.querySelectorAll('[' + t.attr + ']'), function (b) {
                                b.classList.toggle('bf-mode-active', b.getAttribute(t.attr) === mode);
                            });
                            if (pad) {
                                pad.clear();
                                if (mode === 'draw') { pad.on(); } else { pad.off(); }
                            }
                            if (mode === 'type') { renderTyped(key); } else { mirror.pads(); }
                        }
                        Object.keys(TYPERS).forEach(function (key) {
                            var t = TYPERS[key];
                            Array.prototype.forEach.call(
                                document.querySelectorAll('[' + t.attr + ']'), function (b) {
                                b.addEventListener('click', function () {
                                    setMode(key, b.getAttribute(t.attr));
                                });
                            });
                            var ti = document.getElementById(t.name);
                            var ts = document.getElementById(t.style);
                            var fi = document.getElementById(t.file);
                            if (ti) { ti.addEventListener('input', function () {
                                if (t.mode === 'type') { renderTyped(key); } }); }
                            if (ts) { ts.addEventListener('change', function () {
                                if (t.mode === 'type') { renderTyped(key); } }); }
                            if (fi) { fi.addEventListener('change', function () {
                                loadImage(key, fi.files && fi.files[0]); }); }
                        });

                        Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-clear]'), function (btn) {
                            btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                                var id = btn.getAttribute('data-clear');
                                var p = pads[id];
                                if (p) { p.clear(); }
                                Object.keys(TYPERS).forEach(function (key) {
                                    var t = TYPERS[key];
                                    if (t.canvas !== id) { return; }
                                    t.uploaded = false;
                                    if (t.mode === 'type') {
                                        var ti = document.getElementById(t.name);
                                        if (ti) { ti.value = ''; }
                                    }
                                    var fe = document.getElementById(t.file);
                                    if (fe) { fe.value = ''; }
                                });
                                mirror.pads();
                            });
                        });

                        // ── Render the document (PDF.js) + numbered placement markers ──────
                        (function renderDoc() {
                            var docEl = document.getElementById('bf_doc');
                            if (!docEl) { return; }
                            var pdfUrl = docEl.getAttribute('data-pdf');
                            var box = document.getElementById('bf_markers');
                            var markers = box
                                ? Array.prototype.slice.call(box.querySelectorAll('.bf-marker')) : [];

                            function wireClick(m) {
                                m.addEventListener('click', function () {
                                    var inputId = m.getAttribute('data-input');
                                    var target = inputId ? document.getElementById(inputId) : null;
                                    if (!target) {
                                        var type = m.getAttribute('data-type');
                                        target = document.getElementById(
                                            type === 'initials' ? 'bf_card_initials' : 'bf_card_signature');
                                    }
                                    if (target && target.scrollIntoView) {
                                        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                                    }
                                    if (target && target.tagName === 'INPUT') {
                                        setTimeout(function () { target.focus(); }, 250);
                                    }
                                });
                            }
                            function placeOn(pageEl, num) {
                                markers.forEach(function (m) {
                                    if (parseInt(m.getAttribute('data-page'), 10) !== num) { return; }
                                    m.style.left = (parseFloat(m.getAttribute('data-x')) * 100) + '%';
                                    m.style.top = (parseFloat(m.getAttribute('data-y')) * 100) + '%';
                                    m.style.width = (parseFloat(m.getAttribute('data-w')) * 100) + '%';
                                    m.style.height = (parseFloat(m.getAttribute('data-h')) * 100) + '%';
                                    pageEl.appendChild(m);
                                    wireClick(m);
                                });
                            }
                            function fallback() {
                                docEl.innerHTML = '<div class="bf-doc-fallback">' +
                                    'Aperçu du document indisponible. ' +
                                    '<a href="' + pdfUrl + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' +
                                    'Ouvrir le document</a></div>';
                            }
                            function wireMirror() {
                                var sigM = markers.filter(function (m) {
                                    return m.getAttribute('data-type') === 'signature'; });
                                var iniM = markers.filter(function (m) {
                                    return m.getAttribute('data-type') === 'initials'; });
                                function apply(ms, u) {
                                    ms.forEach(function (m) {
                                        m.style.backgroundImage = u ? ('url(' + u + ')') : '';
                                        m.classList.toggle('bf-marker-filled', !!u);
                                    });
                                }
                                function paintPad(key, ms) {
                                    var c = document.getElementById(TYPERS[key].canvas);
                                    apply(ms, (c && hasContent(key)) ? c.toDataURL('image/png') : '');
                                }
                                mirror.pads = function () {
                                    paintPad('signature', sigM);
                                    paintPad('initials', iniM);
                                };
                                ['bf_pad', 'bf_pad_initials'].forEach(function (id) {
                                    var c = document.getElementById(id);
                                    if (!c) { return; }
                                    ['pointerup', 'pointerleave', 'mouseup', 'touchend'].forEach(function (ev) {
                                        c.addEventListener(ev, function () { setTimeout(mirror.pads, 0); });
                                    });
                                });
                                markers.forEach(function (m) {
                                    var inputId = m.getAttribute('data-input');
                                    if (!inputId) { return; }
                                    var input = document.getElementById(inputId);
                                    var valEl = m.querySelector('.bf-marker-value');
                                    if (!input || !valEl) { return; }
                                    var sync = function () {
                                        valEl.textContent = input.value || '';
                                        m.classList.toggle('bf-marker-filled', !!input.value);
                                    };
                                    input.addEventListener('input', sync);
                                    input.addEventListener('change', sync);
                                    sync();
                                });
                            }

                            // Odoo bundles pdf.js as an ES module; loaded as a classic <script src>
                            // its top-level `export` throws and window.pdfjsLib is never set on this
                            // standalone page. Load the module on demand via dynamic import().
                            import('/web/static/lib/pdfjs/build/pdf.js').then(function (pdfjsLib) {
                            try {
                                pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc =
                                    '/web/static/lib/pdfjs/build/pdf.worker.js';
                            } catch (e) { /* worker optional */ }
                            return pdfjsLib.getDocument(pdfUrl).promise.then(function (pdf) {
                                docEl.innerHTML = '';
                                var chain = Promise.resolve();
                                var width = Math.min(docEl.clientWidth || 720, 760);
                                var ratio = Math.max(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1);
                                for (var p = 1; p <= pdf.numPages; p++) {
                                    (function (num) {
                                        chain = chain.then(function () {
                                            return pdf.getPage(num).then(function (page) {
                                                var base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
                                                var vp = page.getViewport({ scale: (width / base.width) * ratio });
                                                var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                                                canvas.width = vp.width; canvas.height = vp.height;
                                                return page.render({
                                                    canvasContext: canvas.getContext('2d'), viewport: vp
                                                }).promise.then(function () {
                                                    var pageEl = document.createElement('div');
                                                    pageEl.className = 'bf-page';
                                                    var img = document.createElement('img');
                                                    img.className = 'bf-page-img';
                                                    img.alt = 'Page ' + num;
                                                    img.src = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
                                                    pageEl.appendChild(img);
                                                    docEl.appendChild(pageEl);
                                                    placeOn(pageEl, num);
                                                });
                                            });
                                        });
                                    })(p);
                                }
                                return chain;
                            }).then(function () {
                                wireMirror();
                            });
                            }).catch(function (e) {
                                if (window.console) { console.error('bf_sign: rendu document échoué', e); }
                                fallback();
                            });
                        })();

                        document.getElementById('bf_form').addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
                            // Ensure typed text is rendered onto the canvas before reading it.
                            function ready(key) {
                                if (TYPERS[key].mode === 'type') { renderTyped(key); }
                                return hasContent(key);
                            }
                            function missingMsg(key, label) {
                                var m = TYPERS[key].mode;
                                if (m === 'type') {
                                    return key === 'initials'
                                        ? 'Veuillez saisir votre paraphe.' : 'Veuillez saisir votre nom.';
                                }
                                return (m === 'upload' ? 'Veuillez téléverser ' : 'Veuillez apposer ') + label + '.';
                            }
                            if (!ready('signature')) {
                                e.preventDefault(); alert(missingMsg('signature', 'votre signature')); return false;
                            }
                            if (pads['bf_pad_initials']) {
                                if (!ready('initials')) {
                                    e.preventDefault(); alert(missingMsg('initials', 'votre paraphe')); return false;
                                }
                                // The canvas holds the paraphe in all modes (drawn, typed or uploaded).
                                document.getElementById('bf_ini_data').value =
                                    document.getElementById('bf_pad_initials').toDataURL('image/png');
                            }
                            if (!document.getElementById('bf_consent').checked) {
                                e.preventDefault(); alert('Veuillez cocher la case de consentement.'); return false;
                            }
                            // The canvas holds the signature in all modes (drawn, typed or uploaded).
                            document.getElementById('bf_sign_data').value =
                                document.getElementById('bf_pad').toDataURL('image/png');
                            document.getElementById('bf_submit').disabled = true;
                            document.getElementById('bf_submit').textContent = 'Traitement…';
                        });
                        var rf = document.getElementById('bf_refuse_form');
                        if (rf) {
                            rf.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
                                if (!window.confirm('Confirmer le refus de signer ce document ?')) {
                                    e.preventDefault();
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    })();

                    (function () {
                        var card = document.getElementById('bf_match');
                        if (!card) { return; }
                        var expected = (card.getAttribute('data-expected') || '').toLowerCase();
                        var drop = document.getElementById('bf_drop');
                        var input = document.getElementById('bf_file');
                        var pick = document.getElementById('bf_pick');
                        var out = document.getElementById('bf_result');
                        var subtle = window.crypto && window.crypto.subtle;
                        // WebCrypto only exists in a secure context. On plain HTTP, or in an
                        // old browser, the drop zone would swallow the file and answer
                        // nothing — worse than not offering it. Fall back to the command.
                        if (!expected || !subtle || !window.FileReader) {
                            drop.style.display = 'none';
                            document.getElementById('bf_nocrypto').style.display = 'block';
                            return;
                        }
                        // A 100 MB read blocks the tab for seconds; signed bundles are a
                        // fraction of that, so anything bigger is almost surely the wrong
                        // file and is better sent to the command line.
                        var MAX_BYTES = 100 * 1024 * 1024;

                        function show(kind, title, detail) {
                            out.className = 'bf-result bf-r-' + kind;
                            out.textContent = '';
                            var head = document.createElement('strong');
                            head.textContent = title;
                            out.appendChild(head);
                            if (detail) {
                                // textContent, not innerHTML: `detail` carries a filename
                                // chosen by whoever prepared the file.
                                out.appendChild(document.createTextNode(detail));
                            }
                            out.style.display = 'block';
                        }

                        function toHex(buffer) {
                            var bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
                            var hex = '';
                            for (var i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
                                hex += (bytes[i] < 16 ? '0' : '') + bytes[i].toString(16);
                            }
                            return hex;
                        }

                        function check(file) {
                            if (!file) { return; }
                            if (file.size > MAX_BYTES) {
                                show('ko', 'Fichier trop volumineux pour être vérifié ici.',
                                     'Le document signé fait normalement quelques mégaoctets. ' +
                                     'Utilisez la commande ci-dessous pour ce fichier.');
                                return;
                            }
                            show('busy', "Calcul de l'empreinte…", file.name);
                            var reader = new FileReader();
                            reader.onerror = function () {
                                show('ko', "Le fichier n'a pas pu être lu.",
                                     'Réessayez, ou utilisez la commande ci-dessous.');
                            };
                            reader.onload = function () {
